summary:
I developed FishNet, a mobile application idea that helps fishermen accurately track and locate fish shoals in real time.
​My app idea addresses the challenge of unpredictable fishing yields and wasted fuel by combining NASA Earth observation data—such as sea surface temperature, ocean currents, and chlorophyll concentrations—with predictive mapping to identify high-probability fishing zones. Instead of searching blindly across vast waters, fishermen can view clear, accessible maps showing where fish populations are likely gathering.
​This solution is important because it empowers local fishing communities to save time, reduce fuel costs, and increase their catch efficiency while staying safe at sea. Furthermore, by guiding fishermen directly to abundant zones and avoiding sensitive breeding areas, FishNet promotes sustainable fishing practices and protects marine ecosystems from overfishing and unnecessary fuel pollution.

FishNet is a mobile app that helps fishermen locate fish shoals in real time without wasting fuel or time searching blindly.

​Safe & Sustainable Routes: Guides boats directly to active zones while alerting them to avoid protected breeding areas and rough weather.
